IN THE HIGH COURT OF KARNATAKA, DHARWAD BENCH  DATED THIS THE 12TH DAY OF JUNE, 2023  BEFORE  THE HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE M.G.UMA  MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL NO.104156/2019 (LAC)

 KARNATAKA NIRAVARI NIGAMA LIMITED,

 KNNL, MLBCC, DIVISION NO.2,
 NAVILUTEERTH-591 126,
 TQ-SAUNDATTI, DIST-BELAGAVI.

AND: 
 1. THE SPECIAL LAND ACQUISITION OFFICER,
 MP-III, BAGALKOTE,
 NOW AT SECTOR NO.60, NAVANAGAR,
 BAGALKOTE-587103.
 2. SRI SHIDRAMAPPA SHIVALINGAPPA DODAWAD,
 AGE: MAJOR, OCC: AGRICULTURE,
Digitally signed by R/O: VAKKUND-591 102,
ROHAN HADIMANI TQ: BAILHONGAL, DIST: BELAGAVI.
T  ...RESPONDENTS  THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 74(1) OF RIGHT TO  FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND  ACQUISITION, REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT,
 2013, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED  15.04.2019 PASSED IN LAC.NO.682/2017 ON THE FILE OF THE  I ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, BELAGAVI  AND ETC.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS  DAY, THE COURT PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
Karnataka Niravari Nigama Limited vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 12 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104138097/
1  -2-  MFA No. 104156 of 2019  ORDER
Learned counsel for the appellant is absent.
No representation is made even after the matter is being passed over thrice and again called at 4.00 p.m.

The order sheet dated 31.05.2023 reads as under:
"Learned counsel for the appellant is absent.
The appeal is of the year 2019.

I do not find any reason to adjourn the matter,
however, in order to afford final opportunity, list this matter on 12.06.2023."
Inspite of that, there is no representation.
I do not find any reason to adjourn the matter.
The appellant is not interested in prosecuting the appeal.

Hence, the appeal is dismissed for default, i.e.,
for non prosecution.
SD/-
